question:
**Select the correct active voice form of the given sentence**

A cartoon film is being watched by Praveen.

options.text: Praveen is watching a cartoon film
Praveen would like to watch a cartoon film.
Praveen had been watching a cartoon film.
Praveen is watched a cartoon film.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Praveen is watching a cartoon film'.**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Active Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He is riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike is being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'A cartoon film' and the object of the given sentence is 'Praveen'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• Here, 'is being watched' will be changed into 'is watching'. 
 
• The preposition 'by' will be removed.

 

Correct Sentence:__ Praveen is watching a cartoon film.*
